% section titles (toc + PDF bookmarks), captions (lof), and the .aux
% round-trip. The harness compiles this twice, so a fragile macro that
% corrupts the .aux fails the second pass.

\subsection{Symbols in bookmarks: \euro100, \yen100, \degrees}

Two footnotes with a label on the first: the kernel must freeze the
footnote number at label time.\footnote{First footnote.\label{sec:fnfirst}}
Another.\footnote{Second footnote.}
Cross-reference: footnote~\ref{sec:fnfirst}.

% Self-asserting regression (#55 follow-up): if \thefootnote were protected,
% the label would freeze as the unexpanded macro and resolve to the CURRENT
% counter value (2) when read back — this makes the second pass error.
\makeatletter
\AtEndDocument{%
  % \relax means pass 1 (no .aux yet, \ref predefined the csname): skip.
  % The invariant: the kernel froze the footnote NUMBER at \label time, so
  % the stored label may contain robust formatting (\oldstylenums{1}) but
  % never an unexpanded \thefootnote — that is the bug this guards against
  % (a protected \thefootnote resolves to the wrong number at read-back).
  % \pdfmatch is pdfTeX-specific; the harness compiles fixtures with pdflatex.
  \expandafter\ifx\csname r@sec:fnfirst\endcsname\relax\else
    \edef\lnptest@all{\csname r@sec:fnfirst\endcsname}%
    \def\lnptest@car#1#2\lnptest@nil{\def\lnptest@first{#1}}%
    \expandafter\lnptest@car\lnptest@all\lnptest@nil
    \edef\lnptest@str{\detokenize\expandafter{\lnptest@first}}%
    \ifnum\pdfmatch{thefootnote}{\lnptest@str}=1
      \errmessage{robustness-test: footnote label froze unexpanded: \lnptest@str}%
    \fi
  \fi
}
\makeatother

\end{document}
